deals.comment: CJ ENM CO., Ltd. (KOSDAQ:A035760) acquired additional 36.9% stake in Jk Film Co.Ltd. from Gil, Young Min and Yoon, Je-kyun for KRW 15 million on June 18, 2021. Under the terms of transaction, 8,671 shares were sold at KRW 1,730 per share and CJ ENM CO. currently hold 51% stake and post completion it holds 87.8% stake in company.

CJ ENM CO., Ltd. (KOSDAQ:A035760) acquired remaining 29.84% stake in Blaad Studios Co. Ltd from Yong Hwa Kim and others for KRW 22.6 billion on October 24, 2022. As per the terms of the deal, CJ ENM CO., Ltd. will acquire 1232 shares of Blaad Studios Co. Ltd each for KRW 18.375 million. Post-completion, CJ ENM CO., Ltd. will own 100% stake in Blaad Studios Co. Ltd. The Board of Directors of CJ ENM CO., Ltd has resolved the deal on October 24, 2022, and the expected date of signing the stock purchase contract is October 24, 2022.

CJ ENM CO., Ltd. (KOSDAQ:A035760) agreed to acquire remaining 47% stake in Bon Factory Co.,Ltd from Kwang Hee Oh and Seok Hwan Moon for KRW 37.6 billion on October 24, 2022. As per the terms of the deal, CJ ENM CO will acquire 56,959 shares from Kwang Hee Oh and 56,960 shares from Seok Hwan Moon each for KRW 330,058. Post-completion, CJ ENM CO., Ltd. will own 100% stake in Bon Factory Co.,Ltd. The Board of Directors of CJ ENM CO., Ltd has resolved the deal on October 24, 2022, and the expected date of signing the stock purchase contract is October 24, 2022.

CJ ENM CO., Ltd. (KOSDAQ:A035760) signed an agreement to acquire the remaining 10.15% stake in Jk Film Co.Ltd. from Je Gyoon Yoon for KRW 5.074 billion on October 24, 2022. The number of shares to be acquired is 2,388. The transaction was approved by the board of directors on October 24, 2022.

CJ ENM CO., Ltd. (KOSDAQ:A035760) agreed to acquire unknown minority stake in Toons Family Co., Ltd. from Dong Woo Kim for KRW 18.56 billion on October 24, 2022. Post completion, CJ ENM CO., Ltd. will own 100% shares in Toons Family Co., Ltd..

CJ ENM CO., Ltd. (KOSDAQ:A035760) agreed to acquire remaining 39.71% stake in Yongfilm Inc. from Seung Yong Lim for KRW 15.9 billion on October 24, 2022. As per the terms of the deal, CJ ENM CO., Ltd. will acquire 5,000 shares of Yongfilm Inc. each for KRW 3,177,100. Post-completion, CJ ENM CO., Ltd. will own 100% stake in Yongfilm Inc. The Board of Directors of CJ ENM CO., Ltd has resolved the deal on October 24, 2022, and the expected date of signing the stock purchase contract is October 24, 2022.
